links.comparator_used: Direct external validation of the model without recalibration (uncalibrated probabilities) on MIMIC-IV and GUH
links.outcome: External-validation discrimination (AUC) for ICU atrial fibrillation risk prediction
links.effect: Direct external validation AUCs reached 0.77 (internal validation AUC 0.81); recalibration gave performance matching or exceeding internal validation
links.quote: However, recalibration resulted in performances matching or exceeding that of the internal validation.
